title: River of Smoke

vibeProfile.oneLine: Ghosh's sweeping epic of the opium trade on the eve of war in Canton.

summary: The second novel of Amitav Ghosh's Ibis trilogy carries a cast of merchants, painters and exiles to the teeming foreign enclave of Canton on the eve of the First Opium War. Ghosh recreates the world of the nineteenth-century opium trade in dazzling detail, from botany and painting to the pidgin tongues of the China coast. Sweeping, sensuous and superbly researched, it is a rich historical epic about commerce, addiction and empire, and a feast for readers who love a fully imagined world.
whyReadIt: The second Ibis novel, a sumptuous historical epic of the opium trade and old Canton. Superbly researched and richly imagined.

funFacts.text: It is the middle volume of Ghosh's acclaimed Ibis trilogy about the opium trade.
